//: Copy to deploy.json before packaging (npm run dist). deploy.json is not under version control; empty values mean Spica as published. See docs/design/desktop-shell.md section 9.
// updateSource: Default update and announcement source for every install: a shared folder (\\server\share\spica) or an http(s) address. Empty: none.
// app: Your own name for the app. Example: { "name": "Nova Desk", "id": "com.example.nova", "icon": "branding/nova.ico", "font": "branding/NovaSans-Bold.ttf" }. name becomes the window title, the installer and shortcut names, %APPDATA%\<name> and Documents\<name>; no < > : " / \ | ? * in it. A new name needs a new id (dotted, like com.example.app) so it does not mix with Spica. icon (.ico) and font (.ttf/.otf, for the wordmark; the built-in one has Latin letters only) are optional, paths relative to this file. Leave all empty to stay Spica.
// models: Company preset model connections, listed first under 服务商 in Settings > Models. Each: id, name, kind (openai-compatible / anthropic / wso2), baseUrl, tokenUrl and scope for wso2, models [{ id, label, contextWindow, role default/strong/cheap }], optional default, maxConcurrent, requestsPerMinute. No keys or secrets: each person types their own (packaging stops if one is here). Example: {"id": "acme-gateway", "name": "公司模型网关（示例）", "kind": "openai-compatible", "baseUrl": "https://llm.example.com/v1", "default": true, "models": [{"id": "acme-chat", "label": "日常", "contextWindow": 128000, "role": "default"}, {"id": "acme-pro", "label": "重活", "contextWindow": 200000, "role": "strong"}]}
